about: The reconciliation of specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md against the rendered page of the scanned PDF (kb/Work PB4850). Every one of the 976 pages was compared by the batch passes of 2026-11-06 (claims, an adversarial verify and a second opinion; a box pass over every page). A page with no claim was found to agree with its transcription. Each claim carries its decision: APPLIED (with the edit, read against the rendered page first), REFUTED, ALREADY (repaired before), FORMAT (a general format, decided by figures-1985), BOX (a level-2 box, marked from the box pass), FIGURE (an illustration) or KEPT. A sweep is a sibling of an applied claim found on the page or across the file. Each box carries MARKED (and the number of blocks marked with a pair of ║), FORMAT or NOT MARKED. verify_publishable.py --edition 1985 holds the transcription to this ledger.
